purpose: Private, provenance-aware resource registry for the Kubera Design Engineering System.

resources.name: Kubera Theme Playground / UI Kit
resources.performance: no new runtime dependency in this phase
resources.whenToUse: Current internal reference for semantic themes and approved glass controls.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not import the lab route or its review controls into production pages.

resources.name: Premium Cyan Optical Glass
resources.attribution: Preserve MIT notice when distributing dependency/source-derived work.
resources.ssr: React client material; isolate browser effects
resources.accessibility: normal DOM content, explicit contrast/focus required
resources.performance: V5 lab performance PASS; limit concurrent lenses
resources.whenToUse: Focal CTA/card/surface with rich backdrop information.
resources.whenNotToUse: Every card, long-form reading surface, or broad navigation chrome.

resources.name: tweakcn
resources.performance: large application; not a runtime dependency
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not copy the full application or make it a site runtime dependency.

resources.name: Liqui Design
resources.stack: React, Base UI, Tailwind v4, shadcn registry
resources.accessibility: native controls and Base UI patterns; audit required
resources.performance: canvas displacement plus SVG filter; measure before adoption
resources.whenToUse: Alternative optical component architecture if Kubera material coverage has a measured gap.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not install alongside approved material without a decision record.
evidence: README and packages/glass repository view reviewed 2026-10-05

resources.name: Theme Generator for shadcn/ui
resources.stack: Next.js 14 App Router, Tailwind, shadcn, Lucide, Recharts
resources.performance: small reference app; not a dependency
resources.whenToUse: Color editor, preset, export, and contrast-checker workflow.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not import its color model without reconciling Kubera semantic roles.

resources.name: applecn
resources.stack: Next.js, React, Base UI, shadcn registry, Hugeicons
resources.browserSupport: web project; independent Kubera test required
resources.whenToUse: Tokens-as-data, platform providers, registry metadata, agent skill design.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not copy Apple branding, measured assets, or platform claims into Kubera.

resources.name: shadcn Registry protocol
resources.license: Protocol/docs; each resource retains its own license
resources.stack: JSON registry, CLI, namespaced authenticated sources
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not expose private registry credentials or unreviewed dependencies.

resources.name: next-themes
resources.license: MIT (verify exact repository notice at adoption)
resources.ssr: supports App Router and no-flash initialization
resources.telegram: not sufficient for Telegram adapter alone
resources.accessibility: color-scheme support; component contrast remains consumer responsibility
resources.whenToUse: If persistent production multi-theme switching is approved.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not add only to solve the isolated lab, which already works.

resources.name: TMA.js / @tma.js/sdk-react
resources.license: MIT ecosystem; verify package notice at adoption
resources.stack: TypeScript, React integration, Telegram Mini Apps
resources.whenToUse: Init data, theme, viewport, Back Button, haptics, and platform events.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not assume browser-only behavior equals Telegram behavior.

resources.name: TelegramUI
resources.whenToUse: Telegram-native control behavior and visual conventions.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not force Telegram visual language into ordinary Kubera marketing pages.

resources.name: gentpan/liquidglass
resources.commercialUse: YES for code; demo assets require separate rights
resources.performance: map reuse and browser fallbacks; Kubera benchmark absent
resources.whenToUse: Cross-browser optical architecture and agent skill pattern.
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not reuse demo images or add a second glass runtime without a gap.

resources.name: shadcn-studio
resources.license: MIT plus Commons Clause per repository license
resources.whenNotToUse: Do not copy or redistribute before legal review of Commons Clause.
